description: Encode (linear -> normalized full-range code value) and decode (code value -> linear) samples for display and camera transfer functions. 'encode' is the 128-sample ramp the CG0 10-bit/log fixtures are built from (code values outside 0-1 are clamped only when a fixture quantizes them); 'encodeExtra' holds segment breaks and negative inputs.
license: Generated numeric reference data; no third-party content. Same terms as the repository.

float64Port.use: A float64 port of the same closed-form equations (CG1 color-science) must match every encode/decode sample within absolute 1e-12 or relative 1e-12.

tolerances.anchors: Each anchor states its own tolerance: the precision of the published value (half a 10-bit code value for published integer codes).

ocioCrossCheck.use: Agreement between colour-science (float64) and OpenColorIO (float32 CPU, optimization off), relative to max(|value|, 1). Shows two independent implementations agree; not a port tolerance.
